## Algorithm

## Design

## Physics Convention

* [The beam-exchange mirror identity and its visibility bound](beam-mirror-identity.md) - |M_ba(p1,p2,q)|² = |M_ab(p1,p2,Rq)|² with R reflecting only outgoing legs; per-leg record fields swap under exchange; the 0.076 ŝ/(ŝ+m_Z²) bound that tests the reflected term.
